map.计算数值变化的百分比。: Compute the percentage change of a value.
map.负值表示下降。: A negative value indicates a decrease.
map.计算同比增长率、价格涨跌幅度: Compute year-over-year growth rates and price swings
map.对比实验前后指标变化: Compare metric changes before and after an experiment
map.原价 80，现价 100：变化率=(100-80)/80×100%=25%（涨: Original price 80, new price 100: change rate = (100−80)/80×100% = 25% (a 25% rise). Reversed, 100→80 gives (80−100)/100 = −20% (a 20% fall). Note the base differs, so the results differ.
map.先涨 10% 再跌 10%：100×1.1×0.9=99，并非回到 100，因为: A 10% rise then a 10% fall: 100×1.1×0.9=99, not back to 100, because the second 10% is based on the larger base.
map.变化的基数怎么选？: change: how is the base chosen?
map.统一用「（新-旧）/旧×100%」。涨跌幅不对称：从 80 到 100 是 +2: Always use "(new−old)/old×100%". Rises and falls are asymmetric: from 80 to 100 is +25%, from 100 back to 80 is −20%, because the denominator changed.
map.多个百分比能直接相加吗？: Can multiple percentages be added directly?
map.不能直接加。复合变化用连乘 (1+r1)(1+r2)…-1，因为每次都基于新的基: They cannot be added directly. Compound changes use multiplication (1+r1)(1+r2)…−1, because each is based on a new base.
